$comment: Evidence map for Phase 27. This records current artefacts; it does not claim deployment, persistence, or production completion.

areas.area: Products, versions and listings are explicit
areas.requirement: Marketplace products require vendor identity, versions remain linked to packages, and listings are discoverable records.
Inactive products and private products outside the target tenant are excluded from discovery.

areas.area: Vendor verification and publishing authority are governed
areas.requirement: Vendor verification is monotonic and publishing authority cannot be granted by an unauthorized member.

areas.area: Package security and compatibility are evaluated before installation
areas.requirement: Malware, invalid signatures, excessive data access, missing APIs and permission conflicts block or flag packages.

areas.area: Entitlements expire and installations advance safely
areas.requirement: Expired or suspended entitlements fail closed and installation transitions cannot skip authorization.

evidence.contains: installation advances one stage at a time

areas.area: Marketplace policy, incidents and audit events are explicit
areas.requirement: Recommendations require approval, malicious products can be removed, incidents advance through controlled stages, and audit events are recorded.

areas.area: Vendor webhook delivery is authenticated and replay-limited
areas.requirement: Webhook delivery requires valid signatures, acceptable event age and rate limits.

areas.area: Marketplace records are persisted and enforced at a live boundary
areas.requirement: Tenant-isolated persistence and a live authorized installation boundary store and enforce marketplace records.
